behavior_under_test: `relia distill --input <json-or-jsonl> --format json` drafts an `avoid` rule from the planted recurrence cluster with correct PR citations.

scorecard.check: distill accepts explicit local input without requiring pre-persisted .relia experience shards
scorecard.evidence: TestDistillInputDraftsAvoidRuleFromPlantedRecurrenceCluster runs relia distill --input against the governed examples/demo/seeded-repo/outcomes.jsonl JSONL fixture.

scorecard.check: planted recurrence cluster drafts an avoid rule
scorecard.evidence: Generated avoid rule has status candidate, review label suggested, evidence.count 3, and contradictions 0.
Generated provenance includes PR citations for 142, 187, and 203 with https://github.com/Clyra-AI/relia-demo-seed/pull/<pr> URLs.

scorecard.check: canonical signature keys prevent unrelated held-fix evidence from contaminating the avoid rule
scorecard.evidence: The seeded fixture includes held-fix PR 210 with the same signature_id but a different canonical signature key; avoid evidence remains exp_0142, exp_0187, and exp_0203 only.

scorecard.check: stable signature ID/check/key keeps related positive evidence in the same distill cluster
scorecard.evidence: TestDistillStableIDCheckKeyClustersPositiveEvidence verifies a revert, CI failure, and held fix with the same stable signature ID/check/key share a distill cluster key.

scorecard.check: stable and generated canonical distill keys include check name
scorecard.evidence: TestDistillSeparatesReusedStableSignatureIDsByCheckName and TestDistillSeparatesCanonicalSignatureClustersByCheckName verify same signature IDs or generated signatures with different check_name values draft separate avoid rules.

scorecard.check: matching message fingerprints still co-cluster across different checks
scorecard.evidence: TestDistillClustersMatchingMessageFingerprintsAcrossChecks verifies two failures with different check_name values but the same message_fingerprint draft one recurrence-backed avoid rule.

scorecard.check: explicit blank distill input is rejected
scorecard.evidence: TestDistillRejectsBlankExplicitInput verifies relia distill --input " " exits with usage validation instead of falling back to persisted shards.
Implementation reuses local ingest normalization and redaction, does not call network or provider endpoints, and preserves signature-only deterministic fallback.
